messages:
lee: Heads-up — after merging the attention-optim kernels PR the CI runtime image jumped ~14% in size. Build artifact attached by build-bot shows extra PTX sections stacked into the fatbin. Anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: Yup i noticed locally too. nvcc started embedding PTX for multiple compute capabilities. Our gencode list expanded when the new kernels added sm_86 and sm_89 targets. Bundling both PTX+cubin for every arch explodes fatbin size.

aj: Typical culprit is the -gencode flags. Current compile line in CI is:
```
nvcc -O3 -lineinfo -gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode=arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -rdc=true -c src/kernel.cu -o kernel.o
```
That will emit PTX *and* cubin blobs depending on code options. You can trim by making PTX emit only for one arch (e.g. highest) and use `code=sm_XX` for the others, or explicitly set `code=compute_86` vs `sm_86` depending on whether you want PTX. Also check `-Xptxas` output to see register and local memory use.

lee: Good call. What about using separate PTX artifacts (ptx-only package) so the runtime image only gets cubins? Might help mobile/edge vs host mixes.

maria: I like that. Two suggestions:
1) Build split artifacts: one artifact with `--fatbin`/cubins for runtime, one PTX-only package for model-specific JIT fallbacks.
2) Use sccache for nvcc in CI if we don't already — nvcc compile time is big and caching helps. Our current CI doesn't cache intermediate nvcc outputs.

aj: For CI flags: consider adding `-Xcompiler -ffunction-sections -Xlinker --gc-sections` and passing `-lineinfo` only when debugging. Also try `-Xptxas=-v` to inspect register pressure; reducing register use can shrink generated code in some cases. Example trimmed nvcc snippet:
```
nvcc -O3 -DNDEBUG -gencode=arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode=arch=compute_89,code=compute_89 -rdc=false -c src/kernel.cu -o kernel.o
# then link with: nvlink kernel.o -o kernel.fatbin --gpu-architecture=sm_86
```
(note: `code=compute_89` emits PTX for 89 but not cubin; swap depending on desired output)

sophia: FYI build-bot posted the artifact: /artifacts/pr-4872/runtime-image.tar.gz size=132MB (was 116MB previous). I also ran `cuobjdump --list` and see 3 PTX blobs in the fatbin.

build-bot: build #4872 finished — artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/pr-4872/runtime-image.tar.gz (132.1 MB). CI step: `nvcc-build` -> exit 0.

lee: ok. Plan proposal:
- aj will open an experiment branch that reduces gencode emission (only PTX for fallback arch), and enable `-Xptxas=-v` to capture register/local memory stats in CI logs.
- dev infra will add sccache wrapper for nvcc in the pipeline and a short-lived cache bucket to test speedups.
- add a per-PR size gate script (`ci/size-check`) that compares runtime-image size to main branch and warns >5% regressions.

maria: also add a small script to extract fatbin PTX counts: `cuobjdump --dump-hex --section=.nv_fatbin | grep PTX | wc -l` — we can fail PRs if >2 ptX blobs unless approved.

aj: sounds good. I'll open the branch and post the PR link here. tagging @maria to review the gencode list.

lee: thanks. please include the `--ptxas-options=-v` logs in the CI artifact so we can spot any register spikes. Once we have numbers, we can decide if we need to split artifacts or reduce supported archs by default. :thumbsup:
